text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementPsychologyWhat Makes Life Beautiful?The magic of rhyme and the search for a creator KFBy Kristen French9:30 AM CDT on October 20, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleMany years ago, evolutionary psychologist Nick Humphrey met a family in Turkey with eight children who were unable to walk upright. Due to a genetic disease, they could only get around on all fours. He and his colleagues had traveled to Turkey to study the family and to film them, as an extraordinary example of human development.The children were young adults by the time Humphrey met them and had difficult lives. The other villagers scorned them, and would throw stones at them and tease them. But they seemed to love each other deeply and to enjoy their daily routines.
